 AMD Ryzen 9 9900X + RTX 5070 Ti PCs Get ¥64,000 Discount! PC Shop SEVEN's November 14th Limited-Time Sale
 Nov 14, 2026
 文●さとまさ　編集⚫ASCII
 AI-translated from Japanese. Please refer to the original ASCII.jp article for the authoritative version.
 PC Shop SEVEN, operated by Seven Ar Japan, will hold its "2026/11/14 24-Hour Limited Sale" on November 14th. The sale period is from November 14th, 0:00 to November 14th, 23:59, offering up to ¥64,000 off the latest gaming PCs and desktop PCs. Purchases can be made via the special sale page, with a total of 10 eligible products.
 One highlight is the "ZEFT R60TG." Equipped with Microsoft Windows 11 Home 64-bit, AMD Ryzen 9 9900X, GeForce RTX 5070 Ti, 32GB DDR5 memory, and a 1000GB SSD, it combines an NZXT H9 FLOW RGB White case with an 850W 80 Plus Gold power supply. Normally ¥623,800 (excl. tax), it will be available for ¥559,800 (excl. tax) after a ¥64,000 discount, with free shipping.
 Additionally, the "ZEFT R60IP" features an AMD Ryzen 9 9900X and GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16GB, along with 32GB DDR5 memory and a 1000GB SSD. Normally ¥499,800 (excl. tax), it will be ¥449,800 (excl. tax) after a ¥50,000 discount, also with free shipping. Furthermore, the "Livrra Essential 180" is a mid-tower configuration equipped with an AMD Ryzen 7 8700G, 16GB DDR5 memory, and a 1000GB SSD, available for ¥189,800 (excl. tax) after a ¥10,000 discount from its usual price of ¥199,800 (excl. tax).
 The sale includes a wide range of products, from performance-oriented gaming PCs to desktop PCs for everyday use. All models feature Windows 11 Home 64-bit and high-speed SSD storage, making them suitable for users who want quick boot times and fast application loading. Further details and purchases can be made on the special sale page.
 *Note: Prices and stock information are accurate at the time of publication. Please check the special sale page for the latest information.
